design_search_vs_r41.note: Print surface 0.2 mm under the tip, Bambu tool. Each design at its own blower flow (1 m hose): the duct's pressure at 180 L/min, the flow the blower then gives, the area-mean air speed 0.3 mm over the print within 5, 10 and 14 mm of the nozzle, the air flowing out along the print within 1 mm of it through r 8 mm, and the share of the jets' air leaving the space round the nozzle upward. Most studies ran 600 iterations (within 1 % of 1200 on revision 41; 1-2 points of the near-nozzle air on revision 43's); each case's count is listed.
